semanticAdjudications.adjudication: An unable-to-act owner still ticks at the real regular start. That counted boundary is retained on mode transition; switching to elapsed tracking does not repeat it. A later distinct six-second boundary can tick under the existing rule.
sourcePhrases: whether able to act or not.
Outside combat tick once per 6 elapsed seconds, without double counting.

semanticAdjudications.adjudication: Each native start/end/elapsed deadline remains unchanged. Zero counter rejects reset without spending a reset use. An acquired legal reset/shortening of a positive named counter spends its single numbered-round opportunity; a second one that round is unavailable. It adds neither RP/per-rest stock nor activation.
sourcePhrases: A positive counter can be reset/shortened at most once per ability per round.
Zero counters are not legal reset targets and expend no reset use.
Resets never restore RP or per-rest uses or grant an immediate activation.

completeSourceRechargeParagraph: Recharge N sets a counter to N after use; reduce once at the start of the owner's regular initiative turn, whether able to act or not. Extra turns/Actions do not tick it. Outside combat tick once per 6 elapsed seconds, without double counting. Recharge 2 used on turn 1 is ready on turn 3. A positive counter can be reset/shortened at most once per ability per round. Zero counters are not legal reset targets and expend no reset use. Resets never restore RP or per-rest uses or grant an immediate activation.
